posts.coverText: Ragebait your partner with these dumb questions

slideText.text: Would you still love me if I was exactly like you?
If we were both hungry, who should have to decide what we eat?
Who's more annoying: me, or the person you were before you met me?
If I say "do whatever you want," what do you think I actually mean?
If we broke up for one day, who's texting first?
How do you usually describe me to other people?
What part of me did you not realize you needed until I came into your life?
Can you remember a specific moment when you knew you were falling for me?
What is something about me that makes your life better everyday?
What is one thing about us that feels different from any relationship you have had before?
If you were put on trial for a crime you didn't commit, and the only way to clear your name was for me to give a 10-minute speech on your behalf, how confident are you that you're not going to jail?
If a mad scientist forced you to swap bodies with one of my parents for 24 hours, how are you spending that day without losing your mind?
If we got sucked into a medieval fantasy RPG, what class am I, and are you keeping me in the main party or leaving me at the tavern?
What is the absolute highest amount of money someone could offer you to cut off all communication with me for five years before you'd actually consider it?
If you woke up tomorrow and realized we were both stuck in a time loop repeating today forever, how many loops are you waiting before you tell me?

posts.coverText: 5 ridiculously funny relationship questions to ask tonight

slideText.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how likely are you to pretend to be asleep just to avoid getting up to turn off the lights?
If my terrible singing voice was an actual crime, how many years in prison would I be serving right now?
What is the single most unhinged thing I do in my sleep that you've never had the heart to tell me about?
If we were in a horror movie, who is dying in the first 5 minutes because they insisted on investigating a weird noise?
If you had to describe my driving style using only the name of a natural disaster, which one are you picking?

posts.coverText: 5 questions your girlfriend has to answer (no "both" allowed)

slideText.text: What do you like more about me; my personality or my looks?
If you had to pick one, would you rather spend a whole day with me or a whole day with your best friend?
What's more attractive: when I'm being sweet or when I'm teasing you?
If I stopped texting first, how long would you wait before texting me?
What's one thing I do that secretly annoys you but you don't want me to stop?
Sharing a toothbrush when one of you forgets yours
Matching couple outfits in public
Feeding each other at restaurant
Sleeping in his hoodie when he's not around
Talking to each other in a baby voice
